matched_queries: Employer responsibilities and worker rights: Challenging strike-related dismissal, official versus unofficial action and employer dismissal procedures during strikes.
Discover UK employment guidance for Industrial-action dismissal protections. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
You can ask non-striking employees to cover work during a strike, as long as:

this is allowed by their employment contracts

you do not discriminate against any employee directly or indirectly

Non-union staff and striking

If non-union members go on strike, they are protected from dismissal and have the same rights as union members, as long as the industrial action is lawful.
